lines.en: If you park your car in the wrong place,
lines.zh: 如果你把车停错了地方，

lines.en: a traffic policeman will soon find it.
lines.zh: 交通警察很快就会发现它。

lines.en: You will be very lucky if he lets you go without a ticket.
lines.zh: 如果他让你走而不开罚单，你将非常幸运。

lines.en: However, this does not always happen.
Traffic police are sometimes very polite.
lines.zh: 交通警察有时非常有礼貌。

lines.en: I found this note on my car:
lines.zh: 我在车上发现了这张字条：

lines.en: 'sir, we welcome you to our city. This is a No Parking area.
lines.zh: “先生，我们欢迎您来到我们的城市。这里是禁停区。

lines.en: You will enjoy your stay here if you pay attention to our street signs. This note is only a reminder.'
lines.zh: 如果您注意我们的路标，您会在这里度过愉快的时光。这张字条只是一个提醒。”

lines.en: If you receive a request like this, you cannot fail to obey it!
lines.zh: 如果你收到这样的请求，你不能不遵守它！
